text:
Asha: Dropping a lightweight pass on the batch vectors preview + export presets. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new-ui. Two asks: clear copy for non-ML users and a quick keyboard/a11y sweep.

Ben: Preset dropdown looks good. Suggest presets: Compact, Full, Rerank-ready. Show a single-line helper under the dropdown that updates with the preset summary.

Tori: Copy nits: change modal title from 'Export' to 'Export vectors & metadata'. Footer: 'You will be notified here and by email when the export is ready.' Small: use 'CSV (.csv)' and 'JSONL (.jsonl)' labels.

Max: Backend: previews (first 200 rows) client-side. For exports >5k rows, queue async job and provide in-app link + email. Add soft warning at 20k and require confirm >100k.

Asha: Accessibility: modal needs role="dialog" + aria-modal="true" and focus trap. Announce job state with <div role="status" aria-live="polite">. Preset dropdown needs aria-expanded.

Tori: Keyboard: Tab order should be presets -> mapping table -> sample size -> Export. When a row is focused, Enter opens details; ESC closes and returns focus. Arrow keys move between cells; Home/End go to row start/end.

Ben: Export header suggestion (snake_case):
``
vector_id,text_snippet,relevance_score,vector_dims,source_filename,created_at
```
Include optional original_id and rank_delta. Keep relevance_score to 3 decimals.

Max: We'll implement server-side sort for full datasets. Also allow gzip option for large exports; estimate size before confirm.

Asha: UX microcopy for empty mapping: 'No columns matched. Drag a CSV header here or choose a column to map.' Add 'See examples' link. Also show 'Sampled: 200 rows' badge when previewing subset.

Tori: For screen readers, mark decorative sparklines aria-hidden and provide an aria-describedby with 'score distribution available'.

Ben: Small CSV CTA change: button text -> 'Export vectors (.csv / .jsonl)'. Good to make explicit.

Asha: Quick decision summary: 1) Modal title -> 'Export vectors & metadata'. 2) Preset dropdown with helper copy. 3) Async export >5k, warn >20k, confirm >100k. 4) CSV headers snake_case with optional original_id/rank_delta, relevance_score to 3 decimals. 5) A11y: dialog role, focus trap, aria-live status, preset aria-expanded, sparklines aria-hidden + descriptions. 6) Keyboard: Tab order, Enter/ESC behavior, arrow/Home/End.

Max: I'll spec async job + gzip size estimate. ETA: two weeks.

Tori: I'll draft the keyboard/a11y checklist and run a quick pass after Figma updates.

Ben: I'll update the export microcopy and sample header in the mock.

i18n-bot: Reminder: column labels should be human-readable in UI but machine-friendly in exports. Add i18n keys for UI strings.

Asha: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll file tickets and attach the updated Figma.
